name: Gilbert
housing: Gilbert's rentals are mostly single-family stucco homes in HOA communities, with apartment complexes along the main roads and near the Heritage District.

tenantHelp.name: Maricopa County Legal Assistance for Renters
tenantHelp.what: free legal help for renters facing eviction

climate: Test the air conditioning, photograph the outdoor unit and check the pool equipment if there is one; summer highs often pass 110°F.
fact: Most Gilbert rental homes are in HOA communities, so tenants usually have to follow the HOA's rules on yards, parking and trash.
